testSuiteName: AVANI AGRO FOODS — P0 Lead-Generation Remediation Suite

scenarios.title: Complete, Valid Moringa RFQ Submission & Quotation Engine Validation
scenarios.description: Validated that Moringa RFQ parses normalized quantity (1000 KG), resolves HS Code 1211.90.29, calculates quotation draft, and will NEVER falsely return success if backend database fails.

scenarios.title: Complete, Valid Red Onion RFQ Submission & Quotation Engine Validation
scenarios.description: Validated that Red Onion RFQ correctly maps to Product Master (HS Code 0712.20.00), calculates commercial quotation draft, and enforces authoritative backend response.

scenarios.title: Invalid Email Address Validation & Rejection
scenarios.description: Verified that malformed email strings return HTTP 400, trigger no synthetic ID, and prevent false success confirmation.

evidence.responseError: Valid customer email is required (max 150 chars).

scenarios.title: Missing Mandatory Fields Rejection
scenarios.description: Verified that missing name returns HTTP 400 with descriptive error message without triggering lead creation.

evidence.responseError: Valid customer name is required (max 150 chars).

scenarios.title: Database Persistence Failure Resilience & False-Success Shield
scenarios.description: Verified that if Supabase database rejects the insert, the backend fails loudly (HTTP 500) rather than returning a deceptive HTTP 200, enabling the frontend error recovery card.

scenarios.title: Backend HTTP 500 Error Code Inspection & Zero Synthetic ID Proof
scenarios.description: Audited source code across all three enquiry components: confirmed zero Math.random() fallback inquiry ID generators exist in error blocks. All components require res.ok && data.success === true && data.inquiryId.

scenarios.title: Network Timeout & Offline Catch-Block Resilience
scenarios.description: Verified that network disconnects or fetch aborts trigger catch blocks that set visible error state, preserve user form fields intact, and never display false success checkmarks.

scenarios.title: Deduplication Map Safe-Retry Verification
scenarios.description: Verified that recentSubmissions.set(dedupKey) executes only after database persistence confirms success, and failed attempts purge the dedup key to avoid false duplicate lockouts.

scenarios.title: In-Flight Double-Click Race Condition Guard
scenarios.description: Verified that submit buttons on all three forms enforce disabled={loading} with animated spinners during in-flight network requests, preventing duplicate payload dispatches.

scenarios.title: Notification Provider (Resend) Non-Blocking Decoupling
scenarios.description: Verified that third-party notification delivery (Resend) is non-blocking: leads successfully persisted in Supabase remain safe even if notification webhooks experience downtime.

scenarios.title: Product Catalogue Modal Connected to Central /api/save-lead
scenarios.description: Verified that src/pages/Products.jsx routes modal submissions to /api/save-lead, captures buyer name, email, company, country, quantity, and incoterm, and displays the authoritative inquiry ID from backend.

scenarios.title: Honeypot Spam Trap & Responsive Layout Validation
scenarios.description: Verified that honeypot fields silently trap automated bots (HTTP 200 with AAF-INQ-TRAP-FILTERED without writing to Supabase), and form inputs utilize responsive auto-fit CSS grid layout.
